title: Layerwise INT8 auto-calibration pipeline and runtime ops for activation scaling
creator: Marco Chen
description: Design and implement a layerwise activation-scale aware INT8 post-training quantization pipeline with automated calibration and runtime operator support. Deliver an end-to-end flow: (1) calibration pass that collects per-channel activation statistics and computes robust scaling factors (activation-aware), (2) offline profile generation and storage format in model artifacts, (3) compiler/runtime fusion primitives that apply per-channel requantization at kernel launch, and (4) an accuracy validation harness that gates rollouts and can auto-revert model variants that fail regression thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration tool produces per-layer, per-output-channel scale factors and a JSON profile artifact that can be shipped with model weights
Runtime can load the profile and apply per-channel requantize scales without a separate graph transform at inference time
Integrated microkernel supports fused int8 matmul + requantize path and matches native FP32 top-1/latency tradeoffs within defined thresholds
Automated accuracy validation (eval harness) runs on benchmark prompts and flags regressions >0.5% absolute for generation and >1.0% for embedding similarity
End-to-end benchmark shows >=1.6x token/sec improvement on p4d compared to FP16 baseline for targeted models with <=5% unit-cost increase
implementation_notes: Calibration method: run representative in-distribution traces to collect per-channel activation histograms and dynamic range percentiles; use asymmetric per-channel affine scales computed from 99.995th percentile with outlier clipping; fall back to symmetric min-max for unstable channels
Optionally compute KL-divergence and MSE objectives to choose channel quantization scheme (symmetric/unsigned/asymmetric) per-layer
Profile format: small JSON alongside weights that records layer-id, op-type, per-channel scale list, zero_point if asymmetric, quant_type (INT8/uint8), calibration_sample_count, version
Runtime changes: new operator flags for fused requantize; at kernel dispatch, read per-channel scales from loaded profile buffer and apply during output post-processing to avoid graph rewrites
Kernel work: implement vectorized per-channel requantize loop that uses AVX512/SM_80 intrinsics where available; provide fallback scalar path for older targets
Tooling: add --calibrate and --emit-profile flags to the quantization CLI; output sample statistics CSV for debugging; expose an analysis mode that highlights channels with high variance
Validation: integrate with the eval harness to run nightly regression jobs; store results in benchmark dashboard and annotate rollouts in console with accuracy deltas
